mapper.select: SELECT REPOASST.*,FP.FINPROD_ID FROM INTERF_OPICS_TRAD_REPO REPO JOIN INTERF_TRAD_REPOASST REPOASST ON REPO.ORITRADEID = REPOASST.TRADEID JOIN FIN_PRODUCT FP ON FP.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = REPOASST.SECID || '.' || REPO.MARKET WHERE REPO.ORITRADEID = #{oritradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT PORTFOLIO_ID, ENTRUST_ID, OU_PARTY_ID,QUOTE_ID,CB_FPRICE_AMT,SC_FPRICE_AMT,CP_PARTY_ID ,CP_TRADER_ID cpTrader,REPO_PS ps,OU_TRADER_ID ouTrader FROM IBU_QUOTE_CREP WHERE EXECID = #{oritradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and TRADE_STATUS='07'

SELECT DISTINCT IBU_QUOTE_BOND.ENTRUST_ID, IBU_QUOTE_BOND.PORTFOLIO_ID, IBU_QUOTE_BOND.OU_PARTY_ID,IBU_QUOTE_BOND.QUOTE_ID,IBU_QUOTE_BOND.OU_TRADER_ID ouTrader,IBU_QUOTE_BOND_DET.CP_PARTY_ID,IBU_QUOTE_BOND_DET.CP_TRADER,IBU_QUOTE_BOND.PS FROM IBU_QUOTE_BOND, IBU_QUOTE_BOND_DET WHERE IBU_QUOTE_BOND.QUOTE_ID = IBU_QUOTE_BOND_DET.QUOTE_ID AND IBU_QUOTE_BOND_DET.EXECID = #{oritradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and IBU_QUOTE_BOND.TRADE_STATUS='07' and IBU_QUOTE_BOND_DET.TRADE_STATUS='07'
select t.trade_id from trd_product_deal t where t.f_trade_id = #{fTradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and t.is_cancel = 'N' and substr(t.trade_id, -1) != 'R' AND rownum = 1
